title: Methotrexate as a disease-modifying agent in rheumatoid arthritis
text: Methotrexate inhibits dihydrofolate reductase, interfering with purine and pyrimidine synthesis and thereby suppressing proliferation of immune cells implicated in rheumatoid arthritis. It remains the anchor disease-modifying antirheumatic drug and is frequently combined with biologic agents in patients with an inadequate monotherapy response.
